label: Бригада
description: A 10-sentence usage card for бригада (crew; brigade).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Бригада' is the feminine nominative subject. 'Наша' agrees in the feminine nominative and 'быстро' modifies the verb. A simple workplace statement.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Бригаду' is the accusative direct object of 'собрал'. 'Всю' agrees in the feminine accusative. Note that as a collective the noun declines like an inanimate feminine.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Бригаде' is prepositional after 'в', the group within which the workers are. 'Десять' governs the genitive plural 'рабочих'. A staffing description.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Бригаде' is prepositional after 'в', expressing membership in a crew. 'Строительной' agrees in the feminine prepositional. A common job phrase.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with adjective. 'Бригадой' is instrumental after 'доволен', which governs the instrumental. 'Своей' agrees in the feminine instrumental. A natural workplace sentiment.

missions.phrase: Без хорошей бригады мы не справимся.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive with preposition. 'Бригады' is genitive after 'без', expressing absence. 'Хорошей' agrees in the feminine genitive. A conditional-dependency phrase.

missions.phrase: Мы рассказали бригаде о новом плане.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Бригаде' is the dative indirect object of 'рассказали', the group told. 'О новом плане' is the topic. A clear information-sharing pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a numeral. The numeral 'три' governs the genitive singular 'бригады'. 'На стройке' sets the location. A common quantity construction.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Бригады' is the nominative plural subject of 'закончили'. 'Все' is the agreeing quantifier. Useful for reporting collective results.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. 'Бригадами' is instrumental plural after 'гордится', which governs the instrumental. 'Своими' agrees in the instrumental plural. A pride-in-the-team phrase.
